name: Nosedive
description: Inhabits flight-assist and balance augments. Causes sudden brief vertigo — the sensation of falling — in stable conditions.
observed_behavior: Feeds false vestibular data suggesting downward acceleration. Lasts 0.5-1 second. Occurs 2-5 times per day at unpredictable intervals.
story_hooks: A construction worker on a high beam gets hit with vertigo and survives — then realizes the vertigo hit 2 seconds before the beam gave way, giving them time to grab a cable
